summarization:
The smartphone UI screen displays a "Plans" section with two tabs at the top: "My Plans" and "Discover." The "Discover" tab is currently active. Below the tabs, there are various plan options presented in a grid format, each with an image, title, and duration. The plans include:

1. "GO Launcher-Theme, Wallpaper"
2. "71 Days in Isaiah" (71 Days)
3. "Book Order" (365 Days)
4. "Chronological" (365 Days)
5. "Chronological New Testament" (92 Days)
6. "Classic" (365 Days)

At the bottom of the screen, there is a navigation bar with four icons: Home, Read, Plans (currently selected), and More.
